help.title: Help
help.allAnswered: You’ve seen all questions. Tap Clear chat to start over.

default: Use the left menu to move between matters, chat, calendar, and expenses.
The + button at the bottom-right opens quick actions (help, receive client cash, and wallet spend).
To-do: header checklist icon (right panel). Company assignments stay under Tasks.
dashboard: The dashboard summarizes today’s work and upcoming deadlines.
Tap the checklist icon in the header to open To-do (right panel, Gmail-style).
Tap + at the bottom-right: $ to spend from wallet, down-arrow to receive client cash.
mattersList: Create a matter from the top-right button (if you have permission).
Use filters / search to narrow the list.
Click a matter to open its hub overview.
matterHub: Matter info card: status, client, lead lawyer, and associates.
The lead lawyer can edit associates and per-file view access.
Upload matter documents in the Documents block (lawyer/admin).
matterPlan: Drag steps to reorder the plan.
Each step has its own documents and team comments.
SUPPORT can still comment; only lawyer+ can upload step documents.
matterReport: The report summarizes plan progress, activity, and documents.
You can comment and (with permission) manage matter documents.
Restricted files stay hidden from members who cannot view them.
chat: Pick a conversation on the left or open the @all channel.
You can @mention colleagues and attach files in messages.
Unread badges on Chat in the nav help you catch new messages.
tasks: Assign tasks with an owner and due date; link a matter when needed.
Track TODO / in progress / done on the list.
To-do (personal checklist) is the header icon, not this page.
calendar: See plan and task deadlines by week or month.
Filter by matter or status; click a day to add a plan step.
Use it to prioritize what is due soon.
expenses: This page shows expense stats by period.
Add a transaction quickly: + at the bottom-right → $ (Spend) or down-arrow (Receive).
Expenses only attach to open (not closed/archived) matters.
clients: Client profiles are used when creating matters.
Only Admin/Manager can edit or delete clients.
One client can have many matters.
admin: Admin area: staff, departments, work types, document labels…
Only Admin (and some Manager items) see the full menu.
Be careful changing roles — it affects upload/view permissions.
myWork: To-do opens from the checklist icon in the header (right panel).
Add a task, set date/time, optionally repeat; tick to complete.
Company assignments stay on the Tasks page (/tasks).

createMatter.q: How do I create a matter?
createMatter.a: Go to Matters → Create matter. Fill title, client, lead lawyer, and associates. Admin/Manager usually can create. Then open the matter hub to set the plan and upload documents.

matterMembers.a: The matter’s lead lawyer (or Admin/Manager) opens Matter info → Edit team. Add/remove associates; the lead always keeps access.

planSteps.q: How does the matter plan work?
planSteps.a: Open Plan from the matter hub. Add steps, work type, dates, and status. Drag to reorder. Each step has its own documents and comments.

uploadDocs.a: Matter and plan documents: Admin, Manager, and Lawyer (with matter access). SUPPORT and others can still view (unless denied) and can comment, including comment attachments.

fileAccess.q: How do I restrict who can view a file?
fileAccess.a: Lead lawyer (or Admin/Manager) taps the lock icon on a file → All members / Allow selected / Deny selected. The lead always can view. Comment attachments do not use this ACL.

comments.a: Anyone with matter access can comment (hub, report, plan steps), including SUPPORT. Mentions and comment file attachments are supported.

chatUse.q: How do I use internal chat?
chatUse.a: Open Chat, pick a thread or @all. Send messages, attachments, and mentions. This is company chat — separate from matter comments.

expenses.q: How do I log an expense?
expenses.a: Tap + at the bottom-right → $ (Spend from wallet) or down-arrow (Receive client cash). For spend: pick an open matter, type, and amount. See stats on Expenses / Wallet.

roles.a: ADMIN: full admin. MANAGER: broad view and matter/client management. LAWYER: matter work and document upload. SUPPORT: assigned matters and comments; no matter/plan document upload.
